provenance.title: 202 High Complexity Files
provenance.metric: architectureIssues["N High Complexity Files"] — analyzed files where calcComplexity(content).level === "critical", i.e. 1 + Σ(branch-regex hits) > 30 over the RAW file text, comments and string literals included (index.html:1663-1685, 5453-5454)
provenance.baseCountNote: the issue was filed with 202 on the then-main at analyzedAt 1791738325602; re-running the pinned analyzer on the immutable base commit below reports 216 because main advanced (the #2001/#2002 splits added files) — acceptance is the drop on the delivered branch.
provenance.afterTipNote: the after snapshot was taken with git archive on the measured commit below. The commits after it touch only this record, its test and the fixture file: the .mts test is not a code extension (the analyzer's codeExts has .ts but not .mts) and the .json/.md record is text, so complexity is scored {score:0,level:'low'} for all three and the measurement is identical.

tradeoffs.complexity: 216 -> 178 flagged files (-38, -17.6 %); every touched original and sibling lands <= 30, so each of the 38 split families leaves the critical set.
tradeoffs.coupling: 101 -> 116 flagged files. Splitting a `package main` test file mints a new file that references the same package-level helpers/constants as its siblings, so the #2002 coupling heuristic (a file that references more than 8 defining files) counts each new sibling as coupled. 23 of the siblings are newly flagged and 15 previously-flagged paths drop off. No production import graph changed and `functions` is unchanged (3539 both sides), so no real dependency was added.
tradeoffs.functions: unchanged (3539 both sides) — no function was added, removed or renamed.
tradeoffs.approach: test-file splits only: the win is mechanical and behaviour-preserving (whole decls move verbatim between files of the same package). Production splits, the TS pure-logic extractions and the server.py package split are deferred with reasons below because each needs a multi-module decomposition to land every sibling <= 30.

deferred.reason: no Rust toolchain in the pipeline image — splits under embedded/docker/ui cannot be compiled or tested in-gate (#2002 precedent)

the embedded .sh/.js/.mjs splits need the Dockerfile COPY set and the codeflow bridge/shim copy-set updated in the same change; deferred to the change that owns those boundary guards so they stay in one commit

every remaining TS/Python flag needs a multi-module decomposition, not the plan's single extraction: osv-scanner.ts's severity half carries 72 of its 139 branch hits, last-json-scanner.ts's string-state machine 80 of its 130, and server.py (386) needs roughly a dozen modules because its inline _BRIDGE_JS/_UI_REWRITES string literals carry 84 of its hits. Shipping the plan's one-file seam would leave both siblings > 30 and not move the metric.
